caption: The drawing depicts a brass or bronze-colored oil lamp with a dual-burner design. The central component is a horizontal cylindrical reservoir mounted on a single, rounded, and flaring pedestal base. Two identical glass chimneys, which are slightly iridescent with hints of blue, pink, and purple hues, are positioned symmetrically at each end of the cylindrical reservoir. Each chimney is held in place by a brass or bronze fitting attached to the top of the reservoir. A vertical brass or bronze rod rises from the center of the reservoir and extends upward, ending in a circular ring. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorative elements. Near the base and towards the right, the artist’s signature "J. Carmella." is visible.
title: Reading Lamp
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
